title: Risk Stewards: Cap and IRM Changes on Aave V3 / 2026.10.29
headline: LlamaRisk recommends supply cap, borrow cap and interest-rate changes across several Aave V3 instances, including a cbETH supply cap increase on Base and cap reductions on Avalanche and X Layer.
summary: LlamaRisk's Risk Steward post for 2026.10.29 recommends these Aave V3 changes: raise USDT optimalUsageRatio on Core from 92% to 94%; raise the cbETH supply cap on Base from 60,000 to 70,000; cut the WAVAX supply cap on Avalanche from 16,000,000 to 14,000,000; raise USDC Slope1 on Arbitrum from 4.10% to 4.20%; and on X Layer cut the PT-USDG-29OCT2026 supply cap from 50,000,000 to 1, cut the USDe supply cap from 100,000,000 to 25,000,000 and cut the USDe borrow cap from 20,000,000 to 10,000,000. Reasons given: cbETH on Base is at 94.0% supply cap utilization (56,378 of 60,000) with concentrated suppliers; WAVAX is at 101.9% utilization and the new cap sits below current supply; the PT-USDG reserve matured on October 29, 2026 and a cap of 1 closes new deposits while holders can still withdraw or redeem; USDe on X Layer uses 2.7% of its supply cap. The Arbitrum USDC change moves the borrow rate at the optimal point from 4.10% to 4.20% APR.
